Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Narre Warren South

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Narre Warren South. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Narre Warren South has grown quickly, and we look after everything from the first-generation estate roofs through to the older homes around the township. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Narre Warren South: What We Commonly See

Narre Warren South is largely estate housing, built out through the 1990s and 2000s around Casey Central and the Amberley Park and Strathaird estates. Most of those roofs are now old enough for the first round of maintenance and replacement. Set well inland, they deal with heat, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Narre Warren South are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, re-roofing ageing roofs, and replacing tired guttering and downpipes.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Narre Warren South

Estate roofs are now old enough that a number of Narre Warren South homes are due for a proper look. We re-roof and re-sheet homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, durable and suited to the south-east's hail and UV, and we can match the colour to your existing gutters and trims.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Narre Warren South

Newer roofs still need a roof plumber now and then. Our registered roof plumbers reseal and refix flashings, valleys and ridge capping, and sort out undersized downpipes and overflowing gutters, which are the most common problems on estate homes after heavy rain or a storm.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Narre Warren South

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Narre Warren South Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Narre Warren South Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Narre Warren South locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Narre Warren South Roofing FAQs

My roof is fairly new. Do I still need a roof plumber?

Possibly. Newer roofs can still have poorly sealed flashings, undersized downpipes or storm damage. We can inspect the roof, reseal or refix what needs it and give you an honest opinion.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
